2023年，我等了一年没出一个像样的自走棋，各路神仙整的花里胡哨一点爽感都没有，反倒是以前的《传奇生物》还能给我点快乐……2024终于让我等到你了，单纯而极致的快乐 提点小建议： 一：随从升星立绘请多一点差异化，比如那个猛犸，完全可以1星秃噜皮象，2星壮壮象，3星符文巨象（美术资源肯定会占用一些，但参考《传奇生物》，升星的快乐翻倍有没有） 二：请瑟瑟，是的请瑟瑟，不要让我玩着玩着就退出游戏打开浏览器或者播放器谢谢。 __________________________________________________________________________ 多提一嘴，无尽模式的难度建议调整一下，节奏太快没时间发育，第一轮boss关基本必死，后面只要是boss关就得躺，不想趟就得去拿“最优解”——而在自走棋里找“最优解”显然是病态的。 就像血火组里鹰身女妖+镰刀妹是必拿的，这很不好，你们花费心意做的“装甲熊”及其专有圣物完全没有存在价值，包括平民英雄系列圣物，很明显你们像让一、二阶随从更有存在感和价值，但相对于其他组合，这个收益几乎没眼看。 正好提一下新的建议： 三：羁绊多样化，我指的不是“数值”的堆叠，而是质变，比如“3石化”魔抗+物抗up，“6石化”增加反伤特性；“3风弓”攻速+射程up，“6风弓”攻击目标+1；“3魔潮”回能+法强up，“6魔潮”技能概率晕眩…… 现在羁绊感觉就纯数值堆叠，玩法乐趣上有点局限。
很讽刺的是，去年到今年这么久，那么多自走棋游戏里能玩的下去的还是这款不太正经的游戏

Girls of The Tower? A Journey of Beauty, Strategy, and Potential! (ฅ'ω'ฅ) "This game enchants with a strategic blend of rogue-like, JRPG, and auto chess elements, wrapped in a pixel art package that dazzles despite needing polish in optimization and narrative depth." [h1][b][1] Intro : [/b][/h1] Girls of The Tower emerges as a delightful concoction of Rogue-like mechanics, JRPG elements, auto chess gameplay, and a dash of galgame spice, all wrapped up in a pixel art package that's sure to entice both strategy aficionados and fans of female-led narratives. Developed by Robo Cat Studio and published by OKJOY, the game offers a fresh take on the rogue-like genre, blending strategic depth with engaging storytelling and a vibrant world. Players embark on an adventure with one of four female protagonists, each with her own storyline and charm, navigating through a world teeming with danger and intrigue. The game's core lies in recruiting followers, strategizing formations, and developing one’s town, ensuring each playthrough offers a unique challenge and story unfolding. [h1][b][2] Game Experience : [/b][/h1] At the heart of Girls of The Tower is its strategic gameplay, which has been praised for its foundational strength and addictiveness despite a lack of innovation in auto chess mechanics. The integration of tower climbing, character development, and town management adds layers to the gameplay, enriching the overall experience. The visual presentation, from character portraits to the pixelated minions, is crafted with care, showcasing a blend of aesthetic appeal and functional design. However, the game is not without its flaws; criticisms have been leveled at its optimization issues, with some players experiencing lag and technical hiccups that mar the otherwise smooth gameplay. Additionally, the narrative's reliance on clichés and the desire for more CGs to deepen story immersion point towards areas ripe for improvement. Girls of The Tower stands out for its strategic depth, bolstered by a diverse array of minion cards and the importance of town interactions. The game’s battle system and equipment mechanics offer players a rich tapestry of strategic possibilities, encouraging experimentation and mastery. While the game's adult content is approached with a light touch, it’s the hardcore auto chess mechanics that lie at the core of its appeal. The call for more nuanced character illustrations and requests for more spicy content suggest a community eager for both depth and diversity in game design and narrative. Despite its shortcomings, such as optimization and a need for more content diversity, Girls of The Tower offers a compelling blend of genres that promises a delightful and strategic adventure. [h2][b][3] Final Thoughts : [/b][/h2] In conclusion, Girls of The Tower is a charming yet complex journey through a beautifully pixelated world, where strategy, development, and narrative intertwine to create an engaging experience. While there's room for technical improvements and deeper narrative exploration, the game provides a solid foundation for fans of strategy and enchanting female protagonists. Its potential for growth and expansion makes it a title worth watching, and perhaps, with future updates and community feedback, it will ascend to new heights of gaming delight. 游戏还可以，但是建议构筑的玩法再多一点，派系再多一点。立绘可以更加涩涩一点，希望可以加入棋子被击败之后的大破立绘。牛牛不会骗自己。 问题1：主角卡牌系统比较鸡肋，另外的魔石也是一样的问题，这两东西拿走也不影响这个游戏。首先卡牌现在的战斗时长根本无法撑得起多放几轮法术，所以10几20几张法术根本无所谓，你只会拿你的橙色卡牌来使用。这也造成了一个问题，魔石的永久移除效果根本就是个乐子，我为了移除一张卡然后用绿色卡牌吗，我放着橙卡不用为啥啊， 问题2：法术耗费的问题，普遍5+ 6+ 8+ 其实完全没必要，然后希望所谓的BUFF卡牌效果更加有意义一点，比如使一个棋子变成火伤，完全没必要，还不如直接丢出去，全体变火伤（可以是持续XX秒 或者费用高一点全体永久火伤），然后一些加攻速加暴击加暴击伤害的卡牌，请酌情考虑改成全队享受。或者两个主角可以有携带的卡牌格子，放入buff卡牌可以让全队享受效果。 问题3：伤害卡牌等于老太太小拳拳锤胸口，前期还能用用，后期我都懒得丢卡牌了 麻烦，卡牌系统应该是作为战术使用，可以高代价但是一定要有高回报。想走卡牌流根本没戏，没有随从加玩家的回复和法术效果，所以很扯。 问题4：圣物需要重新设计一下，太容易获得，有的效果及其的鸡肋，圣物应该是强大的，而不是现在这种添饭的作用。 问题5：核心的东西，棋子，升级之后没有模型改变，棋子的流派能不能显示，棋子的输出属性能不能显示（寒冰 闪电 火焰 毒），能不能把棋子的技能是输出，辅助，治疗，坦度通过加图标标识出来。 问题6：装备系统也是比较的粗浅，而且非常的随意，后期装备一多要调整起来非常的麻烦，请加入检索，可以检索攻速 暴击 技能伤害让玩家可以快速筛选，而且希望合成系统可以好好重新做一下，希望可以合成神器这种东西，而不是几乎任意两个属性的装备合一合完事了，简直就和结婚一样。

刨去抽取随从这个大问题之外一切良好，但是抽随从这个问题极大。随从池子是固定的，应该是两个主角阵营的随从，以及中立阵营的随从，每样九个，正好合成一个三星。这样的问题在于，你的构筑愈加接近完成，抽到你想要的随从的概率就越低，因为剩余的你需要的随从在池子里的占比下降了，而且这个下降速度极快。我只能说制作组如果考虑过这个问题还保留这样的机制，那就纯属恶心人；如果没考虑到，建议赶紧改，即便不读构筑，令每个随从刷出的概率相同，并且在玩家凑足一个随从的三星成体的时候停止刷出该随从，才是合理的。 简单计算一下抽卡概率。中立卡组统共14种随从，双主角每人12种，统共38种；基础卡池，不算城镇里买的，每种随从九张卡，统共342张卡。为简单起见，我们忽略手牌上限因素。固定一个随从，假设我们已经拿到了n张这个随从的卡牌，并且手中没有其他随从的卡牌，我们计算每次刷新后商店中有该指定随从的概率。因为每种随从都有九张，所以卡池里不是这个给定的随从的卡有333张。商店每次显示五张卡，所以刷新后不出现该随从的情况有C(333,5)=33108454071种。既然我们手中已经有了n张该随从的卡牌，那么卡池中仍剩下(342-n)张卡牌，也就是说，统共会有C(342-n,5)种不同情况出现。也就是说，我们想要求的刷新后商店中再次出现该随从的概率即为(1-C(333,5)/C(342-n,5))。这个数值在n=1的时候就已经达到了不足11.26%，而到了最终的n=8的情况则达到了不足1.50%。玩过二游的大概能想象这个概率大概对应多少抽。

PC上的steam版本，勉强还行，目前没发现什么bug，我给70分 - 能玩玩。但在swich版本下，游戏体验非常非常糟糕，我给30分 - 在各种闪退和bug修复前，不建议入手。以下是swich版本下的问题汇总： 1.游戏经常报错，频繁闪退。一般情况下，平均一个冒险模式通关下，就要闪退2次以上。在无尽模式下，相比冒险模式下略微少些，但也经常闪退。 2.成就一览一直无法点亮。哪怕都全通所有角色了，但所有的图标还都是灰色的。 3.随从图鉴中，X按键失效，即无法查看羁绊。在PC Steam版本中，可以在右上角进行筛选。 4.没有“混沌之路”、“帝国”这两个DLC。Swich版本还比Steam贵很多，但却缺少2个DLC。 5.贸易行的问题：（1）购买物品的数量，可以超出仓库限制上限；（2）布告的文字描述，字太小；（3）物品的买卖只能一次一次按，是否可以：增加按着不放进行连续购买；（4）切换布告按键，是否可以改为：左摇杆下方的左、右按键。

I did a few runs trying out things and this game sure turned out more interesting than expected! I stumbled upon it from a youtube video and knew I would like it. The game puts its main focus on where it matters, which is the combat. The animations are quite satisfying to observe. What I didn't expect to like, however, is the magic system. The magic in this game is incredibly strong! The effects are strong, but the gems truly take things to the next level. You can manacheat like crazy to unleash spell after spell, which is incredibly satisfying. You can turn individual spells into AoE spells, then you can turn AoE spells into global spells. There is also a layer of meta-progression where you can unlock more ease of life features sure as shops, rerolls, more hp, etc. and also make the individual characters stronger. The translation is quite poor, both story-wise and UI-wise. At least with the UI it is somewhat passable, because of the tooltips showing exactly what it refers to, even though you will have no idea what certain relics do. The story is quite fun and easy-going, with some light ecchi elements, but it's also incredibly chinese. You will find a lot of chinese idioms translated mot-a-mot, for example : [quote]"Humans, don't refuse a toast and then drink a forfeit!"[/quote] This is referring to a common practice at Chinese social gatherings where if someone proposes a toast and you refuse to drink with them, you might be "penalized" by having to drink even more as a playful punishment. Or how the red bandits are probably a reference to the Red Turban Rebellion in chinese history, and they praise Lord Aini (which means love you in chinese). Or talking about leftover women. If you find any odd expressions, if you look them up, they make more sense in chinese. I have an odd fixation with owning every dlc of a game, so I bought this one as well. The DLC here offers some deceptive value. Decotine - a whole new character, with her own spells and minions. While it is one character, the story is played in pairs, so there is a story between Decotine and all 4 of the other characters. Journey to Chaos offers a whole new game mode where you operate a single character, but you can recruit from enemies as well, which are not normally accessible. This feels like it caters to more experienced players since the mechanics are not quite well explained. Overall, this is a surprisingly good game and I wholy recommend it.
